title: Susan Gough refuses to amend statement to include non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: As speaking of Sean Kurpatre, I'm reminded to when Susan Go was asked if by a foyer researcher or somebody if they could amend her statement about no extraterrestrials to include non-human intelligence,

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, of a moment in the 2020s involving Susan Gough, a Pentagon spokesperson. He says someone using the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records, asked her to widen her statement that there were no extraterrestrials so it would also cover "non-human intelligence", and that she refused. He brings it up while discussing Sean Kirkpatrick, who ran the Pentagon's UFO office, as a hint that the official denials were worded carefully.
